notes:
Implemented all 12 MCP tools + ToolRegistry in app/mcp_tools/. All tools are async, accept db_session as first param, return dicts, validate required params, handle missing records gracefully, and use explicit SQLAlchemy select() queries (not lazy-loaded relationships) for async session compatibility.

Files created:
- registry.py: ToolRegistry class with register(), get_tool(), get_tool_descriptions(), get_tool_names(), register_all(). Singleton tool_registry instance.
- reservation_tools.py: get_reservation(booking_reference)
- agreement_tools.py: record_agreement(session_id, agreement_type, accepted, guest_response)
- guest_tools.py: update_guest_info(session_id, first_name, last_name, phone)
- otp_tools.py: trigger_otp(session_id), verify_otp(session_id, otp_code)
- id_upload_tools.py: generate_id_upload_link(session_id), record_id_upload(session_id, file_path)
- incidental_tools.py: generate_incidental_link(session_id), record_incidental_selection(session_id, selection_type, amount)
- arrival_tools.py: get_arrival_instructions(session_id) - renders arrival_instructions.html via Jinja2
- faq_tools.py: get_faq_answer(session_id, question), get_current_state(session_id)

Key design decisions:
- All tools use explicit SQLAlchemy select() queries instead of session.guest/session.reservation lazy loads
- FAQ matching uses keyword scoring with stop-word filtering and minimum score threshold of 2
- OTP: 6-digit code, 10-min expiry, 3 max attempts, tracks attempts in OTPVerification
- Incidental: processes payment via MockPayment.process_payment(), creates IncidentalSelection record
- ID upload: uses LinkService for secure token generation
- Arrival instructions: Jinja2 template rendering with reservation data
- ToolRegistry.register_all() registers all 12 tools; singleton tool_registry for app startup

Tests: 39 new tests covering all 12 tools + registry. Full suite: 130/130 passed.
